title: The Glymphatic System in α-Synucleinopathies
journal: Yonsei Med J 第 67 卷第 9 期 · Jeong SH、Chung SJ、Lee PH（韓國首爾延世大學醫學院神經科／龍仁世福蘭斯醫院）· doi:10.3349/ymj.2025.0495
tag: 綜述 · 膠淋巴清除系統 · AQP4
note: → 本篇是narrative review（綜述），不含新的原始數據。作者彙整近年影像、病理與實驗證據，論證膠淋巴系統（glymphatic system）——即經血管周邊路徑與星形膠細胞 aquaporin-4（AQP4）通道進行腦脊髓液廢物清除的全腦網絡——在α-突觸核蛋白病變（含帕金森病、路易氏體失智症與多系統萎縮症）中的角色。要點：進階磁振方法（沿血管周邊間隙的擴散張量影像分析 DTI-ALPS、功能性 BOLD-CSF 耦合）在三種疾病中都顯示膠淋巴流動受損，並與認知及運動退化程度相關；動物與屍檢研究顯示 AQP4 極化受破壞會加劇 α-突觸核蛋白堆積與神經退化；作者並整理目前正在探索的介入方向（睡眠優化、AQP4 藥理調節、器械式方法）。⚠️ 限制：屬綜述而非原始研究，未做系統性回顧或統合分析；DTI-ALPS 是膠淋巴功能的間接替代指標、其效度仍有爭議；文中未提供 MSA 專屬的效果量、亞型細分或診斷閾值；所述治療策略均為研究階段，無任何已完成的 MSA 臨床療效讀出。

en.journal: Yonsei Med J, vol. 67 no. 9 · Jeong SH, Chung SJ, Lee PH (Department of Neurology, Yonsei University College of Medicine / Yongin Severance Hospital, Seoul, Korea) · doi:10.3349/ymj.2025.0495
en.note: → This is a narrative review and contains no new primary data. The authors synthesise recent imaging, pathological and experimental evidence on the role of the glymphatic system — the brain-wide network that clears waste via cerebrospinal fluid moving through perivascular pathways and astrocytic aquaporin-4 (AQP4) channels — in the α-synucleinopathies, comprising Parkinson's disease, dementia with Lewy bodies and multiple system atrophy. Key points: advanced MRI methods (diffusion tensor imaging analysis along the perivascular space, DTI-ALPS, and functional BOLD–CSF coupling) show impaired glymphatic flow across all three diseases, correlating with cognitive and motor decline; animal and postmortem work indicates that disrupted AQP4 polarisation exacerbates α-synuclein accumulation and neurodegeneration; and the authors survey the intervention directions currently being explored (sleep optimisation, pharmacological modulation of AQP4, device-based approaches). ⚠️ Limitations: this is a review rather than original research, and it is neither a systematic review nor a meta-analysis; DTI-ALPS is an indirect proxy for glymphatic function whose validity remains contested; the paper reports no MSA-specific effect sizes, subtype breakdown or diagnostic thresholds; and the therapeutic strategies described are all at a research stage, with no completed clinical efficacy readout in MSA.

title: Regional reduction of high-energy phosphorus metabolites characterizes the cerebellar subtype of multiple system atrophy
journal: npj Parkinson's Disease · Prasuhn J 等，德國呂北克（另兼約翰霍普金斯大學醫學院與 Kennedy Krieger Institute，美國）
tag: 亞型影像生物標記 · 粒線體能量代謝 · 31P-MRSI
note: → 以 31P 磁振頻譜影像（31P-MRSI）在活體測量腦內高能磷酸代謝物（HEP），比較 MSA 的兩個亞型與帕金森病及健康對照。世代為 MSA 24 人（MSA-P 12、MSA-C 12）、帕金森病 24 人、年齡性別配對健康對照 24 人，掃描標的為基底核與小腦。結果：只有 MSA-C 組在小腦顯示 HEP 濃度下降；基底核的 HEP 則在兩個 MSA 亞型、帕金森病與健康對照之間無差異。作者將此定位為 MSA-C 小腦區域性生物能量異常的初步活體證據。⚠️ 限制（作者自陳）：每組僅 12 人，屬初步（preliminary）結果；基底核的陰性發現尤其在 MSA-P 需謹慎解讀，因為此 31P-MRSI 方法的空間解析度有限，未必能偵測到該區域的變化。本研究未評估任何治療，亦未建立診斷閾值。收錄理由：粒線體功能失常長期被提為 MSA 的可能治療標的，而本文提供的是「該標的在哪一個亞型、哪一個腦區可被活體量到」的方法學線索——若後續能放大驗證，對亞型分層與藥效藥理學指標的設計有參考價值。

en.journal: npj Parkinson's Disease · Prasuhn J et al., Lübeck, Germany (with joint affiliations at Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine and the Kennedy Krieger Institute, USA)
en.note: → The study used 31-phosphorus magnetic resonance spectroscopic imaging (31P-MRSI) to measure high-energy phosphorus-containing metabolites (HEPs) in vivo, comparing the two MSA subtypes against Parkinson's disease and healthy controls. The cohort comprised 24 MSA patients (12 MSA-P, 12 MSA-C), 24 with Parkinson's disease and 24 age- and sex-matched healthy controls, with the basal ganglia and cerebellum as the imaging targets. Only the MSA-C group showed decreased HEP levels in the cerebellum; basal ganglia HEP levels showed no difference between the two MSA subtypes, Parkinson's disease or controls. The authors frame this as preliminary in-vivo evidence of regional bioenergetic alteration in the MSA-C cerebellum. ⚠️ Limitations (stated by the authors): only 12 patients per subtype, and the findings are explicitly preliminary; the negative basal ganglia result requires particularly cautious interpretation in MSA-P, because the spatial resolution of this 31P-MRSI approach may not detect changes in that region. The study evaluated no treatment and established no diagnostic threshold. Why it is included: mitochondrial dysfunction has long been proposed as a treatment target in MSA, and this paper contributes a methodological clue as to which subtype and which brain region that target can actually be measured in vivo — which, if replicated at larger scale, would be relevant to subtype stratification and to the design of pharmacodynamic readouts.

title: Does CANVAS mimic MSA-C? A prospective multimodal study
journal: Journal of Neurology 第 273 卷第 9 期（線上先行）· Pei 等，史特拉斯堡大學醫院神經科（法國史特拉斯堡）；合作單位含史特拉斯堡神經科學研究所與史特拉斯堡大學遺傳學暨細胞與分子生物學研究所（IGBMC）· doi:10.1007/s00415-026-14005-7
tag: 鑑別診斷 · RFC1／CANVAS · 前瞻世代 · 存活分析
note: → 直接處理一個實務上難解的鑑別問題：RFC1 基因 AAGGG 內含子重複擴增所致的疾病，典型表現為 CANVAS（小腦性共濟失調、周邊神經病變與前庭反射消失症候群），但也可以表現為合併自律神經失調、巴金森症候群與錐體束症候群的共濟失調——與小腦型多系統萎縮症（MSA-C）在臨床上高度重疊。作者以前瞻、多模態方式描述 RFC1 相關共濟失調的自然史，並找出可與 MSA-C 區辨的特徵。世代為 418 名散發性晚發型小腦共濟失調病人，其中確認 RFC1 相關共濟失調 20 人、MSA-C 65 人。結果：發病年齡較早，以及巴金森症候群、自律神經失調與錐體束症候群出現得較晚、病程進展較慢，均與 RFC1 相關共濟失調顯著相關（p < 0.05）。存活方面，RFC1 相關共濟失調的中位存活期超過 20 年，顯著長於對照的 MSA-C（p < 0.0001）。⚠️ 限制：RFC1 組僅 20 人，樣本數偏小；為單一國家、單一轉診中心的世代，可能有轉診偏誤；文中未報告個別特徵的靈敏度／特異度或診斷閾值，因此上述特徵屬群體層次的關聯，尚不足以直接當成個別病人的診斷準則。收錄理由：MSA 目前仍以臨床準則診斷、無確診生物標記，而誤診會同時污染臨床試驗的收案族群與自然史資料；本篇量化了「看起來像 MSA-C、實則為 RFC1」這一類病人的比例與可資區辨的線索，且存活期相差極大（逾 20 年 vs MSA-C）——這意味著若未做 RFC1 篩檢，混入的病人可能系統性地拉長試驗族群的觀察存活期並拖慢惡化速率，對以進展速率為終點的試驗設計是實質干擾。

en.journal: Journal of Neurology, vol. 273 no. 9 (online ahead of print) · Pei et al., Department of Neurology, Strasbourg University Hospital, Strasbourg, France; collaborating centres include the Institut des Neurosciences de Strasbourg and the Institute of Genetics and Cellular and Molecular Biology (IGBMC), University of Strasbourg · doi:10.1007/s00415-026-14005-7
en.tag: Differential diagnosis · RFC1 / CANVAS · prospective cohort · survival analysis
en.note: → This addresses a genuinely difficult differential. AAGGG intronic repeat expansions in RFC1 typically cause CANVAS (cerebellar ataxia, neuropathy and vestibular areflexia syndrome), but can also present as ataxia combined with dysautonomia, parkinsonism and a pyramidal syndrome — clinically overlapping cerebellar-type multiple system atrophy (MSA-C). The authors set out to describe the natural history of RFC1-related ataxia prospectively and multimodally and to identify features discriminating it from MSA-C. The cohort comprised 418 patients with sporadic late-onset cerebellar ataxia, among whom 20 had RFC1-related ataxia and 65 had MSA-C. Results: earlier age at onset, together with later onset of parkinsonism, dysautonomia and pyramidal signs and slower disease progression, were all significantly associated with RFC1-related ataxia (p < 0.05). On survival, median survival in RFC1-related ataxia exceeded 20 years, significantly longer than in the MSA-C comparator (p < 0.0001). ⚠️ Limitations: the RFC1 group numbered only 20 patients; this is a single-country, single-referral-centre cohort subject to referral bias; and the paper reports no sensitivity, specificity or diagnostic thresholds for individual features, so these are group-level associations rather than criteria that can be applied directly to an individual patient. Why it is included: MSA is still diagnosed on clinical criteria with no confirmatory biomarker, and misdiagnosis contaminates both trial populations and natural-history data. This paper quantifies how often patients who look like MSA-C in fact carry RFC1 expansions and which clues separate them, and the survival gap is very large (over 20 years versus MSA-C) — meaning that without RFC1 screening, misclassified patients would systematically lengthen observed survival and slow apparent progression in a trial population, which materially distorts any design using progression rate as an endpoint.

title: A Standardized Head-Up Tilt Test Protocol to Assess Cardiovascular Autonomic Dysfunction in Neurodegenerative Diseases
journal: Journal of Visualized Experiments (JoVE) 第 234 期 · Suzuki 等，名古屋大學研究所醫學系神經內科與名古屋大學醫院臨床檢驗部（日本名古屋）；合作單位為濱松醫科大學醫院神經內科（日本濱松）· doi:10.3791/72496
tag: 自律神經評估 · 檢查方法標準化 · 影音方法論文
note: → 一篇方法論／操作示範論文（JoVE 為影音格式期刊），提出標準化的傾斜床測試（head-up tilt test）操作流程，用以評估神經退化性疾病的心血管自律神經功能障礙。作者指出自律神經失調是神經退化性疾病常見且具臨床意義的表現，並明確以帕金森病與多系統萎縮症為主要對象；測試的核心是量測由平躺轉為直立姿勢過程中的血壓變化，藉以偵測心血管自律神經衰竭。⚠️ 本篇的性質必須說清楚：這是操作規範與示範，不是臨床研究——沒有病人世代、沒有診斷準確度數據（無靈敏度／特異度／AUC）、也沒有與其他方法的比較，因此不能被引用為任何診斷效能的證據。收錄理由：神經性直立性低血壓是 MSA 診斷準則中的核心項目之一，而傾斜床測試正是其標準量測工具；此類檢查的結果對操作細節（傾斜角度、時長、量測時點、事前用藥與禁食條件）高度敏感，跨中心作法不一會直接影響病人是否符合收案條件。本站先前收錄的復健範疇綜述（PubMed 42615574）已點出 MSA 領域缺乏標準化療效指標的問題，本篇屬於同一方向上、在檢查程序端的標準化嘗試，對日後多中心試驗的一致性有參考價值。

en.journal: Journal of Visualized Experiments (JoVE), issue 234 · Suzuki et al., Department of Neurology, Nagoya University Graduate School of Medicine, and Department of Clinical Laboratory, Nagoya University Hospital (Nagoya, Japan); with the Department of Neurology, Hamamatsu University Hospital (Hamamatsu, Japan) · doi:10.3791/72496
en.tag: Autonomic assessment · protocol standardisation · video methods paper
en.note: → A methods and demonstration paper (JoVE publishes in video format) presenting a standardised head-up tilt test protocol for assessing cardiovascular autonomic dysfunction in neurodegenerative disease. The authors note that autonomic dysfunction is a common and clinically meaningful feature of these disorders and name Parkinson's disease and multiple system atrophy as the principal targets; the test centres on measuring blood pressure changes during the postural transition from supine to upright in order to detect cardiovascular autonomic failure. ⚠️ The nature of this paper must be stated plainly: it is a procedural specification and demonstration, not a clinical study — there is no patient cohort, no diagnostic accuracy data (no sensitivity, specificity or AUC) and no comparison against other methods, so it cannot be cited as evidence of diagnostic performance. Why it is included: neurogenic orthostatic hypotension is one of the core items in the MSA diagnostic criteria, and the tilt test is its standard measurement tool. Results from such testing are highly sensitive to procedural detail — tilt angle, duration, measurement time points, prior medication and fasting conditions — and inconsistent practice between centres directly affects whether a patient meets enrolment criteria. The rehabilitation scoping review recorded here earlier (PubMed 42615574) already flagged the absence of standardised outcome measures in MSA; this paper is an attempt at standardisation in the same direction but on the examination-procedure side, and is relevant to consistency in future multicentre trials.

title: Rehabilitation strategies for atypical parkinsonian syndromes: A scoping review of progressive supranuclear palsy, multiple system atrophy, corticobasal syndrome, and dementia with Lewy bodies
journal: Journal of Parkinson's Disease（線上先行）· Kamo H, Amano S, Gerzenshtein IK 等，通訊作者群含 McFarland NR 與 Shukla AW（佛羅里達大學 Fixel 神經疾病研究所神經科，美國）；合作單位含順天堂大學醫學部神經科（日本東京）、北里大學醫療衛生學部作業療法學科（日本神奈川）、印度全印醫學科學院神經科（新德里）· doi:10.1177/1877718X261440430
tag: 復健與照護 · 範疇綜述 · 非藥物介入
note: → 依 PRISMA-ScR 準則進行的範疇綜述（scoping review），檢索 PubMed、Embase、Web of Science 與 Cochrane Library 自建庫起至 2025 年 5 月，納入探討非侵入性復健（物理治療、職能治療、語言治療）的英文同儕審查文獻，由兩位獨立審查者篩選、歧見經共識或第三位審查者裁決。共 60 篇符合納入條件，分布為進行性核上性麻痺 32 篇、MSA 20 篇、皮質基底核症候群 5 篇、路易氏體失智症 6 篇。結果：跨疾病來看，復健一致地安全且可行；步態與平衡訓練、發聲與吞嚥治療、多模式方案在行動能力、言語與生活品質上顯示短期效益——但作者依美國神經學會（AAN）證據分級將其定為 Class III–IV，即證據等級偏低。作者結論認為高品質證據仍然有限，指出照護上的顯著缺口，並主張需要早期、多專科、針對個別疾病設計的介入，以及標準化的療效指標與長期試驗來確立持續效益。⚠️ 限制：這是範疇綜述而非系統性回顧或統合分析，未做偏誤風險評估、未合併效果量；MSA 僅佔 20 篇且與其他三種疾病合併討論，結論並非 MSA 專屬；檢索截止於 2025 年 5 月，其後文獻未納入。收錄理由：MSA 目前尚無任何具疾病修飾療效的核准藥物，非藥物介入因而是現行臨床照護的主要組成之一；本篇是少數把 MSA 復健證據量化盤點的文獻，同時點出缺乏標準化療效指標——這一點對日後任何以功能性指標為終點的試驗設計都有參考價值。

en.journal: Journal of Parkinson's Disease (online ahead of print) · Kamo H, Amano S, Gerzenshtein IK et al., with McFarland NR and Shukla AW among the senior authors (Department of Neurology, Fixel Institute for Neurological Diseases, University of Florida, USA); collaborating centres include the Department of Neurology, Juntendo University School of Medicine (Tokyo, Japan), the Department of Occupational Therapy, Kitasato University School of Allied Health Sciences (Kanagawa, Japan) and the Department of Neurology, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (New Delhi, India) · doi:10.1177/1877718X261440430
en.tag: Rehabilitation and care · scoping review · non-pharmacological intervention
en.note: → A scoping review conducted per PRISMA-ScR guidance, searching PubMed, Embase, Web of Science and the Cochrane Library from inception to May 2025 for peer-reviewed English-language reports on non-invasive rehabilitation (physical, occupational and speech therapy), with two independent reviewers screening and disagreements resolved by consensus or a third reviewer. Sixty studies met the inclusion criteria: progressive supranuclear palsy 32, MSA 20, corticobasal syndrome 5 and dementia with Lewy bodies 6. Findings: across the disorders, rehabilitation was consistently safe and feasible, and gait and balance training, voice and swallowing therapy, and multimodal programmes showed short-term benefits in mobility, speech and quality of life — though the authors graded these Class III–IV on the American Academy of Neurology classification, i.e. a low evidence level. The authors conclude that high-quality evidence remains limited, highlight significant gaps in care, and argue for early, multidisciplinary and disease-specific interventions together with standardised outcome measures and long-term trials to establish sustained efficacy. ⚠️ Limitations: this is a scoping review rather than a systematic review or meta-analysis, so no risk-of-bias assessment was performed and no effect sizes were pooled; MSA accounts for only 20 of the studies and is discussed alongside three other disorders, so the conclusions are not MSA-specific; and the search ends in May 2025, excluding later literature. Why it is included: MSA still has no approved disease-modifying therapy, which makes non-pharmacological intervention a major component of current clinical care; this is one of the few papers to take a quantified inventory of the MSA rehabilitation evidence, and its point about the absence of standardised outcome measures is relevant to the design of any future trial using functional endpoints.

title: Structural MRI Volumetry Index for Differentiation of Progressive Supranuclear Palsy From Parkinson's Disease and Multiple System Atrophy by Automatic Segmentation: A Comparison With Magnetic Resonance Parkinsonism Index
journal: Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging · Jia M, You H, Liu Z, Wang Y, Wang H, Li M, Feng F（北京協和醫院放射科暨神經科，中國醫學科學院／北京協和醫學院；首都醫科大學附屬北京天壇醫院放射科；協和醫院疑難重症及罕見病國家重點實驗室）· doi:10.1002/jmri.70418
tag: 鑑別診斷 · 自動化影像指標
note: → 提出一個全自動、不依賴特定軟體的腦容積指標 PDSVI（parkinsonism volumetric index），公式為（橋腦體積 × 第三腦室體積）/（中腦體積 × 視丘體積）× 10，用以取代現行需人工在特定切面測量、費時且受判讀者影響的 2D 指標。世代：480 名病人（帕金森病 246、進行性核上性麻痺 108、MSA-C 63、MSA-P 63）加 252 名健康對照，隨機分為訓練組 320、內部驗證組 160。內部驗證結果：PDSVI 區辨 PSP 與非 PSP 的 AUC 0.897，對 PD 0.873、對 MSA-P 0.950、對 MSA-C 0.939、對健康對照 0.909；與人工測量的 MRPI（依序 0.909、0.886、0.923、0.984、0.862）相當。收錄理由：MSA 與 PSP、PD 的生前鑑別是本領域最常見的實務難題，而此指標主張在不犧牲準確度的前提下自動化——對需要跨中心一致納入標準的臨床試驗尤其相關。⚠️ 限制：單一國家、以中國人族群為主，僅有內部驗證、無獨立外部世代；PDSVI 是為了偵測 PSP 而設計，MSA 在此扮演的是「對照組」而非目標診斷，因此高 AUC 反映的是把 MSA 排除在 PSP 之外的能力，不代表能區分 MSA-P 與 MSA-C，也不代表能把 MSA 與 PD 分開。本篇經 JMRI 於 2026/08/13 刊出的社論（PubMed 42596062）評介而納入本站；社論本身為評論，未另收錄。

en.journal: Journal of Magnetic Resonance Imaging · Jia M, You H, Liu Z, Wang Y, Wang H, Li M, Feng F (Departments of Radiology and Neurology, Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College; Department of Radiology, Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University; State Key Laboratory of Complex Severe and Rare Disease, Peking Union Medical College Hospital) · doi:10.1002/jmri.70418
en.note: → The paper proposes a fully automated, software-independent brain volumetry metric, the PDSVI (parkinsonism volumetric index), calculated as (pons volume × third ventricle volume) / (midbrain volume × thalamus volume) × 10, as a replacement for the current 2D metrics, which must be measured manually on specific planes and are both laborious and observer-dependent. The cohort comprised 480 patients (246 Parkinson's disease, 108 progressive supranuclear palsy, 63 MSA-C, 63 MSA-P) plus 252 healthy controls, randomised into a training set of 320 and an internal validation set of 160. In internal validation the PDSVI separated PSP from non-PSP with an AUC of 0.897, and from PD at 0.873, MSA-P at 0.950, MSA-C at 0.939 and healthy controls at 0.909 — comparable to the manually measured MRPI (0.909, 0.886, 0.923, 0.984, 0.862 respectively). journal: Diagnostics (Basel) 16(15):2420 · Aksoy Gündoğdu A 等（土耳其泰基爾達 Namık Kemal 大學醫學院神經科；伊斯坦堡 Aydın 大學醫學院神經科）· doi:10.3390/diagnostics16152420

en.note: → A clinicopathologic mismatch in young-onset parkinsonism: the patient was diagnosed during life with a neurotransmitter synthesis disorder — a class of largely treatable inherited metabolic conditions — and only post-mortem pathology established that the disease was in fact MSA. ⚠️ A single case report; no inference can be drawn about how often this misdiagnosis occurs. journal: Fortschritte der Neurologie-Psychiatrie · Wilkens I, Katzdobler S, Bernhardt A, Höglinger G, Hopfner F（慕尼黑大學附設醫院神經科、德國神經退化疾病中心慕尼黑分部、慕尼黑系統神經學研究群 SyNergy，德國）· doi:10.1055/a-2877-5054
tag: 疾病綜述 · 診斷與研究方向
note: → 德語系神經科教學期刊的 MSA 綜述（線上先行）。整理現行共識：MSA 屬非典型帕金森症候群中罕見且進展快速的一種，臨床上合併帕金森症狀、小腦性共濟失調與自律神經失調；病理核心為寡突膠細胞內錯誤摺疊的 α-突觸核蛋白堆積所驅動的多系統神經退化。診斷依 MDS 診斷準則並輔以 MRI，惟確診仍僅能靠死後病理。目前尚無疾病修飾療法，處置以症狀治療與多科團隊照護為主；作者列出的研究優先方向為生物標記開發與針對 α-突觸核蛋白聚集及神經發炎的介入。⚠️ 本篇為綜述，非原始研究，不含新數據；德文撰寫。 收錄理由：可作為現行診斷準則與領域共識的引用點，「確診仍需死後病理」這一限制，正是本站追蹤中的多項影像與體液生物標記研究（如 MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 造影試驗）所要解決的問題。

en.journal: Fortschritte der Neurologie-Psychiatrie · Wilkens I, Katzdobler S, Bernhardt A, Höglinger G, Hopfner F (Department of Neurology, LMU Klinikum; German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases, Munich site; Munich Cluster for Systems Neurology, SyNergy, Germany) · doi:10.1055/a-2877-5054
en.tag: Disease review · diagnosis and research directions
en.note: → A review of MSA in a German-language clinical neurology journal (online ahead of print), summarising current consensus: MSA is a rare, rapidly progressive member of the atypical parkinsonian syndromes, presenting with a combination of parkinsonism, cerebellar ataxia and autonomic dysfunction, and driven pathologically by accumulation of misfolded α-synuclein in oligodendrocytes causing multisystem neurodegeneration. Diagnosis rests on the MDS criteria supported by MRI, while definitive confirmation remains post-mortem only. There are no disease-modifying treatments; management is symptomatic and multidisciplinary. The authors name biomarker development and interventions targeting α-synuclein aggregation and neuroinflammation as research priorities. ⚠️ This is a review, not primary research: it contains no new data, and is written in German. Why it is included: it serves as a citable statement of the current diagnostic criteria and field consensus, and the limitation it names — that definitive diagnosis is still post-mortem — is precisely the problem addressed by several imaging and fluid-biomarker efforts tracked on this site, such as the MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 imaging study.

title: Nutritional Factors and Weight Loss Predict Tracheostomy-Free Survival in Multiple System Atrophy
journal: Movement Disorders Clinical Practice · Asano Y, Bokuda K, Hayashi K 等（東京都立神經病院神經內科／東京都立府中療育中心，日本）· doi:10.1002/mdc3.70767
tag: 預後因子 · 營養與存活
note: → 回溯分析 215 名 MSA 病人，以無氣切存活期為終點檢驗營養指標的預測力。平均存活 3.3 年（標準差 2.0）。多變量分析顯示三個獨立危險因子：預後營養指數（PNI）偏低（HR 2.12，p = 0.018）、BMI 下降幅度較大（HR 2.90，p < 0.001）、UMSARS 第一部分第 2 項（吞嚥）分數較高（HR 1.59，p = 0.014）。作者結論：以 PNI 與 ΔBMI 衡量的營養狀態惡化，獨立於吞嚥困難嚴重度之外預測較短的存活期。⚠️ 單一國家、以醫院為基礎的回溯世代，非隨機分派亦非介入研究——本研究證明的是「相關與預測」，不是「補充營養可延長存活」。 領域意義：PNI 與 BMI 變化取自例行血液檢查與體重，取得成本遠低於影像或體液生物標記，可作為 MSA 試驗分層與存活分析的候選共變數。

en.journal: Movement Disorders Clinical Practice · Asano Y, Bokuda K, Hayashi K et al. (Department of Neurology, Tokyo Metropolitan Neurological Hospital / Tokyo Metropolitan Fuchu Medical Center for the Disabled, Japan) · doi:10.1002/mdc3.70767
en.note: → A retrospective analysis of 215 patients with MSA tested the predictive value of nutritional measures against tracheostomy-free survival. Mean survival was 3.3 years (SD 2.0). Multivariate analysis identified three independent risk factors: a lower prognostic nutritional index (PNI) (HR 2.12, p = 0.018), a greater decline in BMI (HR 2.90, p < 0.001) and a higher score on UMSARS Part I item 2, swallowing (HR 1.59, p = 0.014). The authors conclude that nutritional decline, captured by PNI and ΔBMI, predicts shorter survival independently of the severity of dysphagia. ⚠️ A single-country, hospital-based retrospective cohort — not randomised and not an intervention study. It establishes association and prediction, not that nutritional support extends survival. Field relevance: PNI and BMI change are derived from routine bloods and body weight, making them far cheaper to obtain than imaging or fluid biomarkers, and therefore candidate covariates for stratification and survival analysis in MSA trials.

title: Magnetic resonance imaging markers predict disease progression in early-stage multiple system atrophy: a 2-year prospective cohort study
journal: The Journals of Gerontology Series A · Zhang L, Lin J, Li C 等，通訊作者 Shang H（四川大學華西醫院神經內科／罕見病中心，中國）
tag: 影像生物標記 · 病程預測
note: → 前瞻世代收案 144 名早期 MSA 病人，依 MSA 專屬 MRI 標記分為影像陽性與陰性兩組，以 UMSARS 總分、蒙特婁認知評估與額葉功能評估追蹤兩年，73 人完成完整追蹤。結果顯示影像陽性組在整體 MSA 與帕金森亞型（MSA-P）的 UMSARS 總分惡化顯著較快（p = 0.002 與 p = 0.020）；校正年齡、性別與基線病程後，影像陽性狀態在第 1 年與第 2 年皆為病程惡化的顯著預測因子（皆 p < 0.05）。作者結論為 MRI 標記除診斷用途外，亦具病程預測價值。⚠️ 單一中心世代，144 人中僅 73 人完成兩年追蹤（流失約半數），且原文摘要未列出構成「影像陽性」的個別標記與判讀閾值；跨中心採用前需確認標記定義與掃描參數一致性。

en.journal: The Journals of Gerontology Series A · Zhang L, Lin J, Li C et al., corresponding author Shang H (Department of Neurology / Rare Diseases Center, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, China)
en.note: → A prospective cohort of 144 patients with early MSA was split into MRI-positive and MRI-negative groups on the basis of MSA-specific MRI markers and followed for two years using the UMSARS total score, the Montreal Cognitive Assessment and the Frontal Assessment Battery; 73 patients completed the full follow-up. The MRI-positive group progressed significantly faster on UMSARS total score, both for MSA overall and for the parkinsonian subtype MSA-P (p = 0.002 and p = 0.020). After adjustment for age, sex and baseline disease duration, MRI-positive status remained a significant predictor of more severe progression at both the 1- and 2-year visits (all p < 0.05). The authors conclude that MRI markers carry prognostic as well as diagnostic value in early MSA. ⚠️ A single-centre cohort in which only 73 of 144 patients completed two years of follow-up (roughly half were lost), and the published abstract does not specify which individual markers and thresholds constitute "MRI-positive"; marker definitions and acquisition parameters would need to be harmonised before multi-centre use.

title: Quantitative susceptibility mapping in neurodegenerative diseases: An umbrella review of iron-related biomarkers and mechanisms
journal: Magnetic Resonance Imaging · Ghaderi S, Mohammadi S, Iturria-Medina Y（蒙特婁神經學研究所／麥基爾大學，加拿大）
tag: 影像生物標記 · 定量磁化率造影
note: → 統合 15 篇系統性回顧的傘狀回顧，檢視定量磁化率造影（QSM）在各神經退化疾病作為鐵沉積生物標記的表現。與 MSA 直接相關的結論是：殼核與蒼白球的磁化率升高可有效區分多系統萎縮症與進行性核上性麻痺、和原發性帕金森氏症，QSM 在偵測病理性鐵累積上優於既有序列。⚠️ 為回顧之回顧、非原始影像資料，各原始研究的族群大小、判讀閾值與掃描參數不一致，臨床採用前仍需標準化。

en.journal: Magnetic Resonance Imaging · Ghaderi S, Mohammadi S, Iturria-Medina Y (Montreal Neurological Institute / McGill University, Canada)
en.note: → An umbrella review synthesising 15 systematic reviews on the performance of quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) as an iron-deposition biomarker across neurodegenerative disease. The finding of direct relevance to MSA: elevated susceptibility in the putamen and globus pallidus effectively separates multiple system atrophy and progressive supranuclear palsy from idiopathic Parkinson's disease, with QSM outperforming established sequences at detecting pathological iron accumulation. ⚠️ This is a review of reviews rather than primary imaging data; cohort sizes, thresholds and acquisition parameters differ across the underlying studies, so standardisation is still required before clinical adoption.

title: GATD3A-mediated monocyte homeostasis and compartmentalized erythrocyte alpha-synuclein discriminate early Parkinson's disease from MSA-P
journal: Frontiers in Immunology · Jiang Y, Xu C, Jin J 等（首都醫科大學附屬北京天壇醫院運動障礙中心／國家神經疾病臨床研究中心，中國）
tag: MSA-P 鑑別診斷 · 血液生物標記
note: → 納入 149 名受試者（帕金森氏症 75 人、MSA-P 74 人），尋找可在早期區分兩者的血液標記。臨床上 MSA-P 病人病程進展較快、自律神經衰竭較嚴重；分子層面，早期 MSA-P 的單核球呈現由趨化因子驅動的侵襲性促發炎型態，帕金森氏症則偏向保護性表現，而紅血球內 α-突觸核蛋白（含膜結合的寡聚體）在兩病間呈現不同的區室化分布。⚠️ 單中心世代、樣本數中等，尚未經獨立族群驗證；本文另有一則同期更正啟事（PubMed 42549319）。記錄價值：MSA-P 與帕金森氏症早期難以區分是此領域反覆出現的收案難題，可及的血液標記若能複製驗證，對縮短診斷時間與試驗篩選有實質意義。

en.journal: Frontiers in Immunology · Jiang Y, Xu C, Jin J et al. (Center for Movement Disorders, Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University / China National Clinical Research Center for Neurological Diseases, China)
en.note: → 149 participants (75 Parkinson's disease, 74 MSA-P) were studied to find blood markers that separate the two conditions early. Clinically, the MSA-P group progressed faster and had more severe autonomic failure; molecularly, monocytes in early MSA-P showed an aggressive, chemokine-driven pro-inflammatory profile where Parkinson's disease trended protective, and erythrocyte alpha-synuclein — including membrane-sequestered oligomers — was compartmentalised differently between the two diseases. ⚠️ A single-centre cohort of moderate size, not yet replicated in an independent population; a correction notice for this article was also published (PubMed 42549319). Why it is recorded: distinguishing early MSA-P from Parkinson's disease is a recurring recruitment problem in this field, and accessible blood markers, if replicated, would meaningfully shorten time to diagnosis and improve trial screening.

title: Early assessment, diagnosis and treatment of Parkinsonism and Related Syndromes study (ExPRESS): a protocol for an observational study on incident parkinsonism
journal: BMJ Open · Fumi RG 等（University College London／劍橋／布里斯托／牛津，英國）
tag: 世代研究 · 早期診斷
note: → 英國多中心前瞻性世代研究計畫書：招募 500 名新發帕金森症候群病人（須在首次專科門診後 12 個月內），其中 120 人於子站點接受深度生物標記評估（血液、部分收集腦脊髓液與皮膚切片、影像），並以病歷連結做終生追蹤。作者指出 MSA 自症狀發生到診斷的中位數為 3.1 年，遠長於帕金森氏症的 1.0–1.2 年；研究目標即改善 MSA 等非典型帕金森症候群的早期辨識，並建立可供疾病修飾治療試驗使用的「trial-ready」世代。

en.journal: BMJ Open · Fumi RG et al. (University College London / Cambridge / Bristol / Oxford, UK)
en.note: → Protocol for a UK multicentre prospective cohort recruiting 500 people with incident parkinsonism within 12 months of their first secondary-care appointment, with 120 participants at subset sites undergoing deep biomarker assessment (blood, and for some CSF and skin biopsy, plus imaging) and lifetime follow-up through medical-records linkage. The authors note that the median time from symptom onset to diagnosis is 3.1 years in MSA, against 1.0–1.2 years in Parkinson's disease; the study aims to improve early recognition of atypical parkinsonian syndromes such as MSA and to build a trial-ready cohort for disease-modifying treatments.

title: Cerebellar Atrophy Modulates Freezing of Gait in Multiple System Atrophy Through Cognitive Dysfunction
journal: CNS Neurosci Ther · Yang H 等（武漢大學人民醫院放射科）
tag: 影像 · 步態凍結與認知
note: → 106 名 MSA 病人（58 名有步態凍結 MSA-FOG、48 名無）以 FreeSurfer 與 SUIT 工具做小腦分區分割：MSA-FOG 組在執行功能、視空間、注意力、工作記憶、語言與延遲回憶皆有缺損，並見全小腦灰質與 I–X 分葉萎縮。迴歸顯示 Crus II 萎縮可獨立預測 N-FOGQ 分數，且執行功能與注意力缺損中介了 Crus II 體積減少與步態凍結嚴重度的關聯。作者提出小腦萎縮可作為 MSA 步態凍結的潛在影像標記。

en.journal: CNS Neurosci Ther · Yang H et al. (Department of Radiology, Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University)
en.tag: Imaging · freezing of gait and cognition
en.note: → In 106 MSA patients (58 with freezing of gait, 48 without), cerebellar lobules were segmented with FreeSurfer and the SUIT toolbox. The MSA-FOG group showed deficits in executive function, visuospatial ability, attention, working memory, language and delayed recall, alongside atrophy of global cerebellar grey matter and lobules I–X. Regression showed that Crus II atrophy independently predicted N-FOGQ scores, with executive-function and attention deficits mediating the association between reduced Crus II volume and freezing severity. The authors propose cerebellar atrophy as a potential imaging marker for freezing of gait in MSA.

title: Pre-Diagnostic Factors Associated with Coding-Based Incident Multiple System Atrophy: A Nested Case-Control Study of the UK Biobank
journal: Mov Disord · Zhao CW 等（Mass General Brigham／哈佛醫學院）
tag: 流行病學 · 風險因子
note: → UK Biobank 巢式病例對照研究：114 例編碼判定之新發 MSA、1,139 例年齡性別配對新發 PD、1,075 名對照。抗組織胺使用、飲酒與身體活動下降在加入 5／10 年潛伏期窗後衰減，提示反向因果；statin 使用於基線與 5 年窗與較低風險相關（OR 0.34，95% CI 0.17–0.69），但與「中度偏高膽固醇亦呈較低風險」（OR 0.41，95% CI 0.24–0.72）方向不一致。唯一隨潛伏期拉長而增強的暴露為居住鄉村（5 年窗 OR 2.73，95% CI 1.32–5.65）。作者結論 MSA 有長期前驅階段，鄉村居住值得進一步研究。

en.journal: Mov Disord · Zhao CW et al. (Mass General Brigham / Harvard Medical School)
en.note: → A UK Biobank nested case-control study of 114 coding-based incident MSA cases, 1,139 age- and sex-matched incident PD cases and 1,075 controls. Antihistamine use, alcohol use and reduced physical activity attenuated once 5- and 10-year latency windows were applied, suggesting reverse causation. Statin use was associated with lower risk at baseline and at 5 years' latency (OR 0.34, 95% CI 0.17–0.69), but this was discordant with the lower risk also seen for moderately elevated cholesterol (OR 0.41, 95% CI 0.24–0.72). Rural living was the only exposure whose effect strengthened with longer latency (5-year OR 2.73, 95% CI 1.32–5.65). The authors conclude MSA has a long pre-diagnostic phase and that rural living warrants further investigation.

title: Multiple system atrophy: cure and care
journal: J Neural Transm · Buonocore J 等（因斯布魯克醫學大學／LMU 慕尼黑／Magna Graecia）
tag: 綜論 · 診斷與照護
note: → 因斯布魯克 Fanciulli／Stefanova 團隊的領域綜論：整理自症狀發生起中位存活 8–10 年、寡樹突膠細胞內 α-synuclein 形成膠質細胞質包涵體的病理核心，以及新版診斷準則與生物標記進展；指出前驅期與其他 α-synuclein 病變重疊仍使早期診斷困難。並直言迄今以 α-synuclein 為標的的治療開發尚未展現一致的臨床效益，現階段管理仍以症狀支持為主，遠距醫療與多專科照護模式正在改變臨床實務。

en.journal: J Neural Transm · Buonocore J et al. (Medical University of Innsbruck / LMU Munich / Magna Graecia)
en.note: → A field review from the Innsbruck group (Fanciulli / Stefanova): median survival is 8–10 years from symptom onset, with α-synuclein accumulating in oligodendroglia as glial cytoplasmic inclusions at the pathological core; new diagnostic criteria and biomarkers have improved recognition, yet prodromal overlap with other α-synucleinopathies keeps early diagnosis difficult. The authors state plainly that α-synuclein-targeted therapeutic development has not yet shown consistent clinical benefit, that management remains largely supportive, and that telemedicine and multidisciplinary care models are reshaping practice.

title: TPPP/p25 amyloid seeding activity as a specific biomarker for multiple system atrophy
journal: Cell · Zeng S 等

en.journal: Cell · Zeng S et al.
en.note: → Reports that TPPP/p25 amyloid seeding activity can serve as a specific biomarker for MSA, helping distinguish it from other α-synucleinopathies (e.g. PD, DLB); a high-impact mechanistic/diagnostic advance for the field.

journal: J Magn Reson Imaging · Candan HE 等

en.journal: J Magn Reson Imaging · Candan HE et al.
en.note: → Uses the substantia nigra susceptibility-to-volume ratio from QSM as an imaging marker to separate PSP from Parkinson's disease and MSA.

journal: J Neurol Sci · Nakagawa Y 等

en.journal: J Neurol Sci · Nakagawa Y et al.

en.journal: Neurology · Freeman R et al.

en.journal: Curr Neuropharmacol · Yuan X et al.

journal: Parkinsonism Relat Disord · Hu S 等

journal: NPJ Parkinsons Dis · Iandolo R 等
tag: 影像 · 病程
note: → 縱貫 MRI 描繪 MSA 皮質變薄的進展——影像指標可作為試驗的客觀次要終點。

title: Validation of orthostatic hypotension in MDS diagnostic criteria for multiple system atrophy
journal: Eur Neurol · Yoshizaki S 等（日本）
tag: 診斷準則 · 姿勢性低血壓
note: → 451 人回溯性病歷比較（臨床可能 MSA 107、帕金森病 223、路易體失智 89、純自主神經衰竭 32）：以 2022 MDS 準則（收縮／舒張壓下降 >20／10 mmHg）判定，MSA 的姿勢性低血壓偵測率由 Gilman 準則的 39.3% 升至 64.5%（p<0.001），但同一準則在帕金森病（39.0%）、路易體失智（67.4%）與純自主神經衰竭（87.5%）也大量命中。收縮壓過衝（overshoot）在 MSA 僅 6.5%，顯著低於路易體失智 21.3%（p=0.002）與純自主神經衰竭 28.1%（p<0.001）。作者結論：MDS 準則對 MSA 的神經性姿勢性低血壓更敏感，而過衝頻率較低可協助與其他 α-synuclein 病鑑別，反映節後自主神經受損較輕。

en.journal: Eur Neurol · Yoshizaki S et al. (Japan)
en.note: → A retrospective chart review of 451 patients (clinically probable MSA 107, Parkinson's disease 223, dementia with Lewy bodies 89, pure autonomic failure 32): applying the 2022 MDS criteria (a fall of >20/10 mmHg systolic/diastolic) raised detection of orthostatic hypotension in MSA from 39.3% under the Gilman criteria to 64.5% (p<0.001), but the same criteria also flagged large fractions of Parkinson's disease (39.0%), dementia with Lewy bodies (67.4%) and pure autonomic failure (87.5%). Systolic overshoot occurred in only 6.5% of MSA, significantly less than in dementia with Lewy bodies (21.3%, p=0.002) and pure autonomic failure (28.1%, p<0.001). The authors conclude that the MDS criteria detect neurogenic orthostatic hypotension in MSA more sensitively, and that the lower overshoot rate may help separate MSA from other synucleinopathies, reflecting less prominent postganglionic autonomic impairment.
